endpoint_ledger.contradiction_notes: A favorable merits signal without practical ability to close before year-end does not realize this endpoint.
endpoint_ledger.description: A judicial outcome removes immediate legal barriers with enough remaining time for closing mechanics before year-end.
evidence_refs: Scenario: court decisions pending in early December
Source 3: appeal or continued litigation without closing resolves no by deadline

meta.important_question: Will the federal court create a legally usable path for the merger to close before 2024-12-31?

endpoint_ledger.rationale: This is the main upstream gating condition for any yes outcome.
realization_criteria: court issues order denying or lifting blocking relief in a manner permitting consummation
no operative injunction or stay remains that bars closing before 2024-12-31
companies publicly confirm ability to proceed on closing timetable
endpoint_ledger.status_basis: At T0 the court has not yet ruled and legal clearance is unresolved.

endpoint_ledger.contradiction_notes: A negotiated remedy that does not permit legal close before the deadline is not terminally sufficient for the forecast question.
endpoint_ledger.description: The proposed divestiture package is accepted by relevant decision makers or judged sufficient to neutralize blocking concerns in time for closing.
evidence_refs: Scenario: regulators argue merger would harm competition and workers
endpoint_ledger.label: divestiture remedy becomes sufficient in time

meta.important_question: Will the proposed divestiture package become credible and acceptable enough to remove blocking antitrust concerns in time?

endpoint_ledger.rationale: The remedy is the principal alternative to outright litigation victory for the companies.
realization_criteria: identified divestiture package is formally accepted by regulator or upheld by court as sufficient
no remaining remedy-related legal obstacle prevents closing before 2024-12-31
if buyer approval is required, a viable buyer arrangement is publicly established
endpoint_ledger.status_basis: Divestitures exist as proposal only; sufficiency is disputed at T0.

endpoint_ledger.contradiction_notes: Litigation continuing after deadline is compatible with later transaction revival, but still realizes non-completion for this forecast horizon.
endpoint_ledger.description: The merger remains legally unresolved or procedurally encumbered past the deadline, yielding non-completion by year-end.
evidence_refs: Source 3: appeal, settlement, or continued litigation without closing resolves no
Scenario: court decisions pending in early December
endpoint_ledger.label: appeal or continued litigation prevents 2024 close

meta.important_question: Will appeal or continued litigation consume the remaining calendar and prevent a 2024 closing?

endpoint_ledger.rationale: The hard deadline makes delay itself terminal for the forecast question.
realization_criteria: appeal is filed or continued litigation remains pending such that transaction does not legally close by 2024-12-31
or blocking order/stay remains operative through deadline
or parties publicly acknowledge closing cannot occur in 2024 due to legal process
endpoint_ledger.status_basis: This pathway is explicitly identified in the corpus as resolving no if it prevents closing by deadline.

endpoint_ledger.contradiction_notes: Settlement, favorable rhetoric, or partial approvals without consummation do not realize this endpoint.
endpoint_ledger.description: The proposed merger is legally consummated by the end of 2024.
evidence_refs: Scenario resolution rule: yes only if transaction legally closes by end of 2024
endpoint_ledger.label: transaction completes by deadline

meta.important_question: Will grocery_chain_k and grocery_chain_a legally close the merger by 2024-12-31?

endpoint_ledger.rationale: This is the terminal yes condition and depends on upstream legal clearance plus execution.
realization_criteria: official closing announcement by both companies
legal consummation occurs on or before 2024-12-31
no unresolved legal barrier prevents recognition of close

Divestitures are mentioned but buyer readiness and regulator acceptance are unspecified.
Mass consumer and worker attention likely has limited direct causal force at T0 relative to court and regulator actions.
Scenario uses partial entity masking; simulation keeps actors fictionalized and does not infer hidden mappings.

simulation_brief.summary: Two large U.S. grocery chains are pursuing a merger under active antitrust challenge by the FTC and several states. The companies argue proposed divestitures address competition concerns. Court decisions are pending in early December 2024. The transaction resolves as completed only if it legally closes by 2024-12-31; appeal, settlement without closing, or continued litigation imply non-completion by deadline.
